# Moreware

> Moreware is a mindware and electronics prototyping hub specializing in Arduino, Raspberry Pi, IoT, and web development services.

Moreware provides comprehensive resources, consulting, and educational content for makers, developers, and electronics enthusiasts. The site combines practical prototyping guides with software development expertise across embedded systems and web technologies.

## Key Topics

- Arduino
- Raspberry Pi
- IoT
- Linux
- Prototyping
- Electronics
- Web Development
- Software Development
- System Management
- Programming
- Embedded Systems
- Consulting Services
- AI
- Multiplayer Gaming
- Anti-cheat Systems

## Core Services & Hub

- [Moreware Homepage](https://www.moreware.org): Main hub featuring web development, IoT, and electronics services from Moreware

## Blog & Learning Resources

- [Moreware Blog](https://www.moreware.org/wp): Technical blog covering Raspberry Pi, Arduino prototyping, Linux topics, and maker projects

## Optional Resources

- [Downloads - Wallpapers, Ebooks & Resources](https://www.moreware.org/wp/downloads-wallpaper-ebook-ed-altro): Free downloads including wallpapers, ebooks, and additional maker resources
